tool_schemas.name: sequentialthinking
tool_schemas.description: Performs the requested sequential-thinking operation (create/get/list/update/cancel runs; create/get/list/update steps and tool calls; create/get/list/update agents) and returns the corresponding entity record(s); list actions return a paginated page controlled by page and page_size, with optional filters and sort applied. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required identifiers are missing for the chosen action, any ULID fails its pattern, page/page_size are out of range, or the request body contains fields not supported by the selected entity; raises NOT_FOUND when run_id/step_id/tool_call_id/agent_id does not exist (or when creating a child object references a non-existent parent); raises CONFLICT when attempting an invalid state transition (e.g., cancelling a completed/failed/cancelled run or step, or updating immutable linkage/order fields such as run_id, step_id, step_index, or sequence_index). Raises UNAUTHORIZED when authentication is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN when you lack permission to access or modify the referenced resources, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

action.description: Operation to perform in the sequential thinking system.

run_id.description: Run identifier (ULID) used for run-scoped operations.

step_id.description: Step identifier (ULID) used for step-scoped operations.

tool_call_id.description: Tool call identifier (ULID) used for tool-call-scoped operations.

agent_id.description: Agent identifier (ULID) used for agent-scoped operations.

body.description: Request body for create/update operations; shape depends on the selected action.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the run.

input_prompt.description: User objective/prompt that initiated the run.

final_output.description: Final outcome text produced when the run completes.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code if the run failed.

error_message.description: Human-readable error message if the run failed.

started_at.description: Timestamp when the run started processing.

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the run finished processing.

run_id.description: Parent run identifier (ULID) for this step.

step_index.description: 0-based order index of the step within the run.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the step.

agent_id.description: Agent responsible for executing this step.

thought.description: Internal reasoning or notes captured for the step.

result.description: Result/output text produced by executing the step.

error_message.description: Human-readable error message if the step failed.

started_at.description: Timestamp when the step started processing.

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the step finished processing.

tool_call.description: Fields for creating/updating a tool call entry.

run_id.description: Parent run identifier (ULID) for this tool call.

step_id.description: Parent step identifier (ULID) for this tool call.

sequence_index.description: 0-based order index of the tool call within the step.

status.description: Execution status of the tool call.

input.description: JSON input payload passed to the tool.

output.description: JSON output payload returned by the tool.

error_message.description: Human-readable error message if the tool call failed.

role.description: Agent role/category used by the system.

enabled.description: Whether this agent can be selected for delegation.

config.description: Arbitrary JSON configuration for the agent.

filters.description: Optional filters for list operations; supported keys depend on the selected action.

status.description: Filter results by status (meaning depends on entity).

page.description: Page number for paginated list operations.

page_size.description: Number of items per page for list operations.

tool_schemas.name: sequentialthinking_auth
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption for the Sequential Thinking Multi-Agent System. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if no valid credentials are presented, and FORBIDDEN if the token is not permitted to introspect.

authorization.description: Bearer access token presented as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

include_rate_limits.description: Whether to include rate-limit and quota consumption details.

page_size.description: Number of records per page for list actions.

sort.description: Sort key; prefix with '-' for descending (e.g., '-created_at').

tool_schemas.name: sequentialthinking_delete
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a run and cascades deletion to its steps and tool_calls. api_requests retention follows policy: by default, linked api_requests rows are retained and their run_id is set to null. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the run does not exist, and CONFLICT if the run is not in a terminal state (completed/failed/cancelled) unless force=true.

force.description: If true, allows deletion of non-terminal runs; may cancel the run first or refuse depending on policy.

retention.description: How to handle associated api_requests records: retain and null out run_id, or delete them.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def sequentialthinking_delete(run_id, force=None, retention=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, random

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0228000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0228000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _now_iso():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    _CROCKFORD = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"

    def _ulid_like(prefix):
        # Not a true ULID, but stable enough for local datastore ids and matches allowed patterns.
        t = int(time.time() * 1000)
        ts = ""
        for _ in range(10):
            ts = _CROCKFORD[t % 32] + ts
            t //= 32
        rand = "".join(_CROCKFORD[random.randint(0, 31)] for _ in range(10))
        return f"{prefix}{ts}{rand}"

    def _match_run_id(s):
        if not isinstance(s, str):
            return False
        if not s.startswith("mas_run_"):
            return False
        tail = s[len("mas_run_") :]
        if len(tail) < 10:
            return False
        for ch in tail:
            if ch not in _CROCKFORD:
                return False
        return True

    t0 = time.time()
    req_id = _ulid_like("mas_req_")
    now = _now_iso()

    # Defaults
    if force is None:
        force = False
    if retention is None:
        retention = "retain_api_requests"

    # Validate inputs
    if not _match_run_id(run_id):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid run_id format.", field="run_id")
    if not isinstance(force, bool):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "force must be a boolean.", field="force")
    if retention not in ("retain_api_requests", "delete_api_requests"):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid retention value.", field="retention")

    # Load store
    runs = _load("runs.json")
    steps = _load("steps.json")
    tool_calls = _load("tool_calls.json")
    api_reqs = _load("api_requests.json")

    # Find run
    run = None
    for r in runs:
        if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("id") == run_id:
            run = r
            break
    if run is None:
        # Log request (observable dynamics)
        api_reqs.append({
            "id": req_id,
            "tool": "sequentialthinking",
            "run_id": None,
            "idempotency_key": None,
            "caller": {},
            "request_headers": {},
            "request_body": {"operation": "sequentialthinking_delete", "run_id": run_id, "force": force, "retention": retention},
            "response_body": _err("NOT_FOUND", "Run not found.", run_id=run_id),
            "http_status": 404,
            "duration_ms": max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)),
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("api_requests.json", api_reqs)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Run not found.", run_id=run_id)

    status = run.get("status")
    terminal = status in ("completed", "failed", "cancelled")
    if not terminal and not force:
        resp = _err(
            "CONFLICT",
            "Run is not in a terminal state; deletion refused unless force=true.",
            run_id=run_id,
            status=status
        )
        api_reqs.append({
            "id": req_id,
            "tool": "sequentialthinking",
            "run_id": run_id,
            "idempotency_key": None,
            "caller": {},
            "request_headers": {},
            "request_body": {"operation": "sequentialthinking_delete", "run_id": run_id, "force": force, "retention": retention},
            "response_body": resp,
            "http_status": 409,
            "duration_ms": max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)),
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("api_requests.json", api_reqs)
        return resp

    # If force and non-terminal, cancel the run first (policy: may cancel then delete).
    # Enforce lifecycle constraints: set completed_at for cancelled, ensure started_at if running.
    if not terminal and force:
        prev = status
        if prev in ("queued", "running"):
            run["status"] = "cancelled"
            if run.get("started_at") is None and prev == "running":
                run["started_at"] = now
            run["completed_at"] = now
            run["updated_at"] = now
        else:
            # Unknown/non-enum state
            resp = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Run has invalid status in datastore.", run_id=run_id, status=prev)
            api_reqs.append({
                "id": req_id,
                "tool": "sequentialthinking",
                "run_id": run_id,
                "idempotency_key": None,
                "caller": {},
                "request_headers": {},
                "request_body": {"operation": "sequentialthinking_delete", "run_id": run_id, "force": force, "retention": retention},
                "response_body": resp,
                "http_status": 422,
                "duration_ms": max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)),
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now
            })
            _save("api_requests.json", api_reqs)
            return resp

    # Cascade delete: steps and tool_calls for this run
    step_ids = [s.get("id") for s in steps if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("run_id") == run_id]
    step_id_set = set([sid for sid in step_ids if isinstance(sid, str)])

    before_steps = len(steps)
    steps = [s for s in steps if not (isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("run_id") == run_id)]
    deleted_steps = before_steps - len(steps)

    before_tool_calls = len(tool_calls)
    tool_calls = [tc for tc in tool_calls if not (isinstance(tc, dict) and (tc.get("run_id") == run_id or tc.get("step_id") in step_id_set))]
    deleted_tool_calls = before_tool_calls - len(tool_calls)

    # Handle api_requests retention policy
    deleted_api_requests = 0
    nulled_api_requests = 0
    if retention == "delete_api_requests":
        before_api = len(api_reqs)
        api_reqs = [ar for ar in api_reqs if not (isinstance(ar, dict) and ar.get("run_id") == run_id)]
        deleted_api_requests = before_api - len(api_reqs)
    else:
        # retain and set run_id null
        for ar in api_reqs:
            if isinstance(ar, dict) and ar.get("run_id") == run_id:
                ar["run_id"] = None
                ar["updated_at"] = now
                nulled_api_requests += 1

    # Delete run itself
    before_runs = len(runs)
    runs = [r for r in runs if not (isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("id") == run_id)]
    deleted_runs = before_runs - len(runs)
    if deleted_runs != 1:
        # Should not happen; do not claim success without effect
        resp = _err("CONFLICT", "Run deletion did not affect exactly one row.", run_id=run_id, deleted_runs=deleted_runs)
        api_reqs.append({
            "id": req_id,
            "tool": "sequentialthinking",
            "run_id": None,
            "idempotency_key": None,
            "caller": {},
            "request_headers": {},
            "request_body": {"operation": "sequentialthinking_delete", "run_id": run_id, "force": force, "retention": retention},
            "response_body": resp,
            "http_status": 409,
            "duration_ms": max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)),
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("api_requests.json", api_reqs)
        return resp

    # Persist cascades
    _save("runs.json", runs)
    _save("steps.json", steps)
    _save("tool_calls.json", tool_calls)
    _save("api_requests.json", api_reqs)

    resp_body = {
        "id": req_id,
        "object": "sequentialthinking.run_deletion",
        "deleted": True,
        "run_id": run_id,
        "retention": retention,
        "effects": {
            "runs_deleted": deleted_runs,
            "steps_deleted": deleted_steps,
            "tool_calls_deleted": deleted_tool_calls,
            "api_requests_deleted": deleted_api_requests,
            "api_requests_run_id_nulled": nulled_api_requests
        }
    }

    # Log this request after mutation (observable dynamics)
    api_reqs = _load("api_requests.json")
    api_reqs.append({
        "id": req_id,
        "tool": "sequentialthinking",
        "run_id": None,  # run no longer exists
        "idempotency_key": None,
        "caller": {},
        "request_headers": {},
        "request_body": {"operation": "sequentialthinking_delete", "run_id": run_id, "force": force, "retention": retention},
        "response_body": resp_body,
        "http_status": 200,
        "duration_ms": max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)),
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now
    })
    _save("api_requests.json", api_reqs)

    return resp_body

tool_schemas.name: sequentialthinking_replay
tool_schemas.description: Replays a stored run by returning its ordered steps and tool_calls as a single trace object suitable for auditing and deterministic playback. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the run does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the run.

include_thoughts.description: Whether to include step.thought fields in the replay payload (may be restricted).

include_request_bodies.description: Whether to include api request/response bodies in the replay payload (may be restricted).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def sequentialthinking_replay(run_id, include_thoughts=None, include_request_bodies=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0228000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0228000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    include_thoughts = False if include_thoughts is None else include_thoughts
    include_request_bodies = False if include_request_bodies is None else include_request_bodies

    # Prepare request logging row (must be appended for every call)
    api_requests = _load("api_requests.json")
    runs = _load("runs.json")
    steps = _load("steps.json")
    tool_calls = _load("tool_calls.json")

    # ULID-ish generator with required prefix
    _CROCK = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
    def _ulid_like(prefix):
        ts = int(time.time() * 1000)
        s = []
        for _ in range(10):
            s.append(_CROCK[ts % 32])
            ts //= 32
        import random
        for _ in range(16):
            s.append(_CROCK[random.randint(0, 31)])
        return prefix + "".join(s)

    req_id = _ulid_like("mas_req_")
    req_row = {
        "id": req_id,
        "tool": "sequentialthinking",
        "run_id": None,
        "idempotency_key": None,
        "caller": {},
        "request_headers": {},
        "request_body": {
            "run_id": run_id,
            "include_thoughts": include_thoughts,
            "include_request_bodies": include_request_bodies
        },
        "response_body": None,
        "http_status": None,
        "duration_ms": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now
    }

    def _finish(resp, http_status):
        dt = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        req_row["response_body"] = resp
        req_row["http_status"] = http_status
        req_row["duration_ms"] = dt if dt >= 0 else 0
        req_row["updated_at"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        api_requests.append(req_row)
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return resp

    # Validate
    if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not re.match(r"^mas_run_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10,}$", run_id):
        return _finish(_err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid run_id format.", field="run_id"), 400)
    if not isinstance(include_thoughts, bool):
        return _finish(_err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "include_thoughts must be boolean.", field="include_thoughts"), 400)
    if not isinstance(include_request_bodies, bool):
        return _finish(_err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "include_request_bodies must be boolean.", field="include_request_bodies"), 400)

    # "FORBIDDEN if caller cannot access the run" — no explicit auth model in schema.
    # Enforce ambient auth by allowing access if run exists (no per-tenant fields to check).
    run = next((r for r in runs if r.get("id") == run_id), None)
    if not run:
        return _finish(_err("NOT_FOUND", "Run not found.", run_id=run_id), 404)

    req_row["run_id"] = run_id

    run_steps = [s for s in steps if s.get("run_id") == run_id]
    run_steps.sort(key=lambda x: (x.get("step_index", 0), x.get("created_at", "")))

    # Tool calls grouped by step
    calls_by_step = {}
    for tc in tool_calls:
        if tc.get("run_id") == run_id:
            sid = tc.get("step_id")
            calls_by_step.setdefault(sid, []).append(tc)
    for sid, arr in calls_by_step.items():
        arr.sort(key=lambda x: (x.get("sequence_index", 0), x.get("created_at", "")))

    # Optionally include api_requests for this run
    reqs_for_run = []
    if include_request_bodies:
        for ar in api_requests:
            if ar.get("run_id") == run_id and ar.get("tool") == "sequentialthinking":
                reqs_for_run.append(ar)
        reqs_for_run.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("created_at", ""))

    def _step_view(s):
        v = {
            "id": s.get("id"),
            "run_id": s.get("run_id"),
            "step_index": s.get("step_index"),
            "status": s.get("status"),
            "agent_id": s.get("agent_id"),
            "instruction": s.get("instruction"),
            "result": s.get("result"),
            "error_message": s.get("error_message"),
            "started_at": s.get("started_at"),
            "completed_at": s.get("completed_at"),
            "created_at": s.get("created_at"),
            "updated_at": s.get("updated_at"),
            "tool_calls": []
        }
        if include_thoughts:
            v["thought"] = s.get("thought")
        return v

    trace_steps = []
    for s in run_steps:
        sv = _step_view(s)
        sv["tool_calls"] = []
        for tc in calls_by_step.get(s.get("id"), []):
            sv["tool_calls"].append({
                "id": tc.get("id"),
                "run_id": tc.get("run_id"),
                "step_id": tc.get("step_id"),
                "sequence_index": tc.get("sequence_index"),
                "tool_name": tc.get("tool_name"),
                "status": tc.get("status"),
                "input": tc.get("input") if include_request_bodies else None,
                "output": tc.get("output") if include_request_bodies else None,
                "error_message": tc.get("error_message"),
                "duration_ms": tc.get("duration_ms"),
                "created_at": tc.get("created_at"),
                "updated_at": tc.get("updated_at"),
            })
        trace_steps.append(sv)

    resp = {
        "run": {
            "id": run.get("id"),
            "status": run.get("status"),
            "input_prompt": run.get("input_prompt"),
            "final_output": run.get("final_output"),
            "error_code": run.get("error_code"),
            "error_message": run.get("error_message"),
            "started_at": run.get("started_at"),
            "completed_at": run.get("completed_at"),
            "metadata": run.get("metadata"),
            "created_at": run.get("created_at"),
            "updated_at": run.get("updated_at"),
        },
        "trace": {
            "steps": trace_steps,
            "api_requests": reqs_for_run if include_request_bodies else None
        }
    }
    return _finish(resp, 200)

tool_schemas.name: sequentialthinking_bulk
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates multiple steps and tool_calls for a run in one request, preserving uniqueness constraints and allowing contiguous step_index enforcement at completion time. Refuses with CONFLICT when (run_id, step_index) or (step_id, sequence_index) uniqueness would be violated, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid lifecycle transitions or disabled agent assignment.

run_id.description: Parent run identifier (ULID) for all records in this batch.

mode.description: Whether to only create new records or upsert by primary keys when provided.

id.description: Optional step id for upsert mode.

step_index.description: 0-based order index of the step within the run.

agent_id.description: Agent responsible for executing this step; must be enabled at assignment time.

thought.description: Internal reasoning or notes captured for the step.

result.description: Result/output text produced by executing the step.

error_message.description: Human-readable error message if the step failed.

started_at.description: Timestamp when the step started processing.

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the step finished processing.

id.description: Optional tool_call id for upsert mode.

step_id.description: Parent step id for the tool call.

sequence_index.description: 0-based order index of the tool call within the step.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the tool call.

input.description: JSON input payload passed to the tool.

output.description: JSON output payload returned by the tool.

error_message.description: Human-readable error message if the tool call failed.

duration_ms.description: Duration of the tool call in milliseconds; must be a non-negative integer when present.

finalize_run.description: If true, attempts to transition the run to completed after applying the batch; refused unless all non-skipped steps are completed and step_index is contiguous starting at 0.

final_output.description: Final output text to store if finalize_run is true.

metadata.name: Sequential Thinking Multi-Agent System
metadata.description: This backend stores conversational “sequential thinking” runs that decompose a user objective into ordered steps, optionally delegating steps to specialized agents. The main workflow is: create a run, generate step-by-step thoughts and agent actions, then finalize with an outcome and store trace/met
